story: [R00] Raid 1 — Encounter 5 begins.

[R12] Dave taunts the boss back.

[R18] Dave taunts the boss back.
[R19] Dave steps out at 4 stacks; Bob takes over.
[R19] Bob taunts the boss back.

[R20] Greg MISTAKE · Moderate · Stood in the Fire
      "The ground was glowing, and Greg decided that was decoration."

[R20] Pip MISTAKE · Minor · Stood in the Fire
      "Pip looked down at exactly the wrong moment and up at exactly the wrong moment."
[R20] Raid 1 — Encounter 5 is defeated.
why: Best case, in FARM gear — Boss 5 capstones included, which a raid only owns after it has already killed Boss 5. A ceiling, not a fight.
